cohort: 39,193 women who gave birth in France between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2019, and experienced postpartum hemorrhage
finding: Cesarean birth, preeclampsia, and uterine rupture are independently associated with intrauterine tamponade failure in the management of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was independently associated with intrauterine tamponade failure (aOR 4.2; 95% CI 2.9-6.0).
